description:
Spawn a new sub-app at https://www.0ncore.com/apps/<slug> by composing one
or more capabilities from the brain registry.

Capabilities (pick from): notes, service_packager, course_builder,
hipaa_scanner, cro9_engine, brand_builder, voice_ai, email_paste, 0nexec,
report_builder.

Modes:
  composer — independent dashboards on a single page (default)
  chain    — workflow with output flowing top-to-bottom

The slug is auto-generated from the name; uniqueness is enforced with a
numeric suffix on collision. Owner is set to the calling user (defaults
to mike@rocketopp.com when called from the MCP).

Returns the new app's URL, slug, and full row.

brief.description: Short description / what the app does

capabilities.description: Array of capability slugs from the brain registry

name.description: Display name for the app, e.g. 'Lead Magnet Engine'

owner_email.description: Owner email — used to look up auth.users.id. Defaults to mike@rocketopp.com.

slug.description: Optional slug override; auto-generated from name if omitted

name: factory_spawn
